fact: The Audit Bureau head said it launched development of an institutional AI model, Diwan Bot, at the start of 2026 to support auditing and oversight analysis; it is described as in development.

Libya Observer reports that the Minister of Labour and Rehabilitation, meeting Al-Nasr Information Technology, was told the ministry's integrated digital platform, supported by AI technologies and linking its departments, was about 30% complete, with standards and the system framework finished.
